description: No credential, or one the gateway does not accept (see the `bearerAuth` scheme). The challenge names where to learn which issuer to sign in at: `Bearer resource_metadata="<origin>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"`, with `error="invalid_token"` first when a credential was presented and refused (RFC 6750 §3, RFC 9728 §5.1). With no credential, the body's `hint` names the header to send; a refused credential is not told why it was refused.
